name: Meeting prep
tagline: Walk into every meeting with a one-pager about the other side
description: Drop in who you're meeting and what it's about. Your team researches their company, recent news, and likely questions — and hands you a one-pager 30 minutes before the call.
starterPrompt: I have a call tomorrow with Alex Chen, head of platform at Acme Corp, about a potential partnership. Research the company, find any recent news in the last 90 days, and write me a one-page brief with: what they do, who I'm meeting, likely questions they'll ask, and three smart questions I should ask.
defaultGoal: Be the most-prepared person in every meeting.
